inlines.v: CROWNING, participle present tense Investing with a crown, or with royalty or supreme power; honoring with a wreath or with distinction; adorning; rewarding; finishing; perfecting. CROWNING, noun 1. In architecture, the finishing of a member or any ornamental work. 2. In marine language, the finishing part of a knot, or interweaving of the strands.
